title: eremophila gibbifolia
intro: Eremophila gibbifolia, commonly known as 'Golden Bird', is a species of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. It is a shrub native to Western Australia, valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eremophila gibbifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, among others.
